subject: general
question: What is the theme of the International Day of Sign Languages 2025, celebrated on 23rd September?

options.text: No Human Rights Without Sign Language Rights

solution:
The correct answer is __**No Human Rights Without Sign Language Rights**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The theme for International Day of Sign Languages 2025 is ‘No Human Rights Without Sign Language Rights’, focusing on the importance of sign language in ensuring equality and inclusion for persons who are Deaf.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **International Day of Sign Languages is celebrated on 23rd September to raise awareness about sign language and its role in ensuring human rights for Deaf persons.**
 
• **ISLRTC is organizing a program to commemorate the day in New Delhi, with Union Minister Dr. Virendra Kumar and Minister of State B.L. Verma attending the event.**
 
• **The theme stresses the significance of sign language for achieving **equality, inclusion, and dignity** for the Deaf community.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Day of Sign Languages**__

 __
 
• Declared by the United Nations General Assembly to raise awareness about sign languages and their importance for the human rights of the Deaf.
 
 
 
• **ISLRTC**__
 
 
• The Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre is dedicated to empowering people with disabilities through sign language training and research.
